title: Duo bar: keep the long press that shows a tab name big
why: At accessibility text sizes the open Duo tab bar caps its labels; a long press shows the name big (iOS large content viewer).
note: Owner ruled page item 53 a at 2026-11-08 16:30 CST: keep the long press. The lane that builds the Duo bar files the decision record and closes debt duo-bar-dynamic-type-clips.
